messages.task:
You are a financial reasoning assistant. Below is background information followed by a list of functions you can call and the task you must accomplish.

Scenario
A JPMorgan Chase & Co. Form-10K discusses the performance of the firm’s common stock versus several equity indices.  The disclosure assumes that an investor put $100 into each investment on December 31, 2013 and then reinvested all dividends.  Cumulative total-return values are reported for calendar-year ends 2013 through 2018 for JPMorgan Chase and for three benchmarks (KBW Bank Index, S&P Financial Index, and S&P 500 Index).

Available tools
1. find_company_id(company_name:str) -> int
   Resolve a textual company name (case-insensitive) to its internal numeric identifier.
2. list_years_for_company(company_id:int) -> List[int]
   Return the set of calendar years for which cumulative-return information exists for a company.
3. get_cumulative_value_for_company(company_id:int, year:int) -> float
   Retrieve the cumulative total-return dollar value for the specified company and year.
4. find_benchmark_id(benchmark_name:str) -> int
   Map a benchmark name to its numeric identifier (may or may not be needed for this task).
5. list_years_for_benchmark(benchmark_id:int) -> List[int]
   List available years for a benchmark (mostly auxiliary information).
6. get_cumulative_value_for_benchmark(benchmark_id:int, year:int) -> float
   Fetch the cumulative value for a benchmark in a given year (auxiliary).

Task
Using ONLY the tools above, determine the average uncompounded annual return (i.e. simple arithmetic average, not geometric) for JPMorgan Chase over the five-year period beginning December 31 2013 and ending December 31 2018.  Return your answer as a percentage rounded to one decimal place, e.g. "12.3%" (without quotes).
